name: Vibe-Trading
description: Turns finance questions into research reports, runnable backtests and paper portfolios for traders and quants, via CLI, web app, API or MCP, with live trades only within a set mandate.

skills.name: Strategy Backtest
skills.description: Backtests a trading strategy described in plain English across equities, crypto and futures, and reports trades and drawdown.

skills.name: Market Research
skills.description: Researches SEC 13F holdings, ETF look-throughs and uploaded filings, and values companies with DCF and peer multiples.

skills.name: Alpha Benchmark
skills.description: Benchmarks alpha factors from Qlib, Alpha101, GTJA and other libraries and checks whether results survive walk-forward tests.

skills.name: Paper Trading
skills.description: Advances a saved paper account one trading day at a time and reports fills, cash and NAV for the simulated portfolio.

skills.name: Research Swarm
skills.description: Runs preset research teams such as a bull-bear investment committee or quant desk and returns each worker's report.
